_comment: Single list of COSY course types. The schema enum in curriculum.schema.json, the folders under curriculums/<lang>/ and the course_type field of every curriculum file must match the keys of `types` (tests/course-types.test.js).

discussion.note: Speaking clubs run in COSYevents, converted to lessons on COSYplatform. Not a course on the COSYlanguages site.

pronunciation.note: Planned as a marathon / course on COSYplatform. Curricula exist; not launched as a course yet.

manualOnly.communication: Exists only as a COSYmanuals folder (manuals/<lang>/communication). Not a course type and has no curriculum.
